verdict.rationale: Nix is software you install and run on your own infrastructure. The docs give a multi-user install script for Linux and macOS, a Docker image, NixOS installation on physical hardware, and an official EC2 AMI. A community user also reports running Nix on their own fleet of remote builders. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license or source availability, and documentation for self-hosting supporting infrastructure such as a private binary cache.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You can install NixOS on physical hardware by burning one of the CD images onto a blank CD/DVD disk
NixOS can be deployed to Amazon EC2 using our official AMI.
Start a Docker shell with Nix: $ docker run -it nixos/nix
Runs on Linux and macOS, next to the package manager you already have.
